StringColumn.Name: FieldName
StringColumn.Caption: Field Name
StringColumn.FullDescription: The name of the field to expose on the form when running this operational action.

StringColumn.Name: Filter
StringColumn.Caption: Filter
StringColumn.FullDescription: Only records matching this filter will be updated.

StringColumn.Name: FieldCaption
StringColumn.Caption: Field Caption
StringColumn.FullDescription: The what to call the field when running this operational action.

ByteColumn.Name: Order
ByteColumn.Caption: Field Order
ByteColumn.FullDescription: The order the fields should be shown on the form when running the operational action.

StringColumn.Name: EmptyBehaviour
StringColumn.Caption: Empty Behavior
StringColumn.FullDescription: Defines how to behave when the action is run with an empty value in this field.

StringColumn.Name: DefaultingStrategy
StringColumn.Caption: Default Method
StringColumn.FullDescription: How the field should be defaulted, the options available depend on the field being updated.

StringColumn.Name: DefaultValue
StringColumn.Caption: Default Value
StringColumn.FullDescription: The default value to be applied to the named field. How this is interpreted depends on the type of field and the selected defaulting method.
